sources.query: 我是里约地区的电商运营负责人，明天要开2018年8月的经营月会。先帮我比较RJ州健康美容品类8月和7月的表现：已送达订单有多少、商品销售额、单均商品金额、配送超时率各是多少？商品销售额不含运费，按下单月份看。告诉我最值得先查的变化。

o.order_id, o.order_status, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date, STRFTIME(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month FROM __ask_scope_orders sources.query: 先做逐单核查。请列出RJ州健康美容品类2018年8月下单、已送达且配送超时的订单，给订单号、客户城市、预计和实际送达日期、超时天数、最低评价星级、评价标题和正文、该订单健康美容商品金额。每笔订单一行，日期仍按下单月份，不限于刚才增长Top5商品。

rows.review_comment_message: Minha compra ainda está presa nos correios. Sei que não é culpa da loja, mas algo deve ser feito! Preciso do equipamento para trabalhar e ele não chegou!

result.sql: WITH __ask_scope_products AS (SELECT p.product_id FROM olist_products_dataset AS p LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t USING (product_category_name) WHERE COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, '未分类') IN ('health_beauty')), __ask_scope_orders AS (SELECT scope_o."order_id", scope_o."customer_id", scope_o."order_status", scope_o."order_purchase_timestamp", scope_o."order_approved_at", scope_o."order_delivered_carrier_date", scope_o."order_delivered_customer_date", scope_o."order_estimated_delivery_date" FROM olist_orders_dataset AS scope_o WHERE scope_o.order_status IN ('delivered') AND scope_o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM olist_customers_dataset WHERE customer_state IN ('RJ')) AND STRFTIME(scope_o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2018-08') AND scope_o.order_id IN (SELECT scope_i.order_id FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS scope_i WHERE (scope_i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM __ask_scope_products)))), __ask_scope_items AS (SELECT scope_i."order_id", scope_i."order_item_id", scope_i."product_id", scope_i."seller_id", scope_i."shipping_limit_date", scope_i."price", scope_i."freight_value" FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS scope_i WHERE (scope_i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM __ask_scope_products)) AND scope_i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)), __ask_scope_olist_customers_dataset AS (SELECT scope_row."customer_id", scope_row."customer_unique_id", scope_row."customer_zip_code_prefix", scope_row."customer_city", scope_row."customer_state" FROM olist_customers_dataset AS scope_row WHERE scope_row.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)), __ask_scope_olist_order_reviews_dataset AS (SELECT scope_row."review_id", scope_row."order_id", scope_row."review_score", scope_row."review_comment_title", scope_row."review_comment_message", scope_row."review_creation_date", scope_row."review_answer_timestamp" FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset AS scope_row WHERE scope_row.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)), __ask_scope_olist_products_dataset AS (SELECT scope_row."product_id", scope_row."product_category_name", scope_row."product_name_lenght", scope_row."product_description_lenght", scope_row."product_photos_qty", scope_row."product_weight_g", scope_row."product_length_cm", scope_row."product_height_cm", scope_row."product_width_cm" FROM olist_products_dataset AS scope_row WHERE scope_row.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM __ask_scope_items)), __ask_scope_product_category_name_translation AS (SELECT scope_row."product_category_name", scope_row."product_category_name_english" FROM product_category_name_translation AS scope_row WHERE scope_row.product_category_name IN (SELECT product_category_name FROM olist_products_dataset WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM __ask_scope_items))), hb_items AS (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.price) AS hb_item_sales FROM __ask_scope_items AS oi JOIN __ask_scope_olist_products_dataset AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN __ask_scope_product_category_name_translation AS t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty' GROUP BY oi.order_id), rev AS (SELECT order_id, MIN(review_score) AS min_review_score, MIN(review_comment_title) AS review_comment_title, MIN(review_comment_message) AS review_comment_message FROM __ask_scope_olist_order_reviews_dataset AS olist_order_reviews_dataset GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_city, CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) AS order_estimated_delivery_date, CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) AS order_delivered_customer_date, DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE), CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE)) AS late_days, r.min_review_score, r.review_comment_title, r.review_comment_message, hb.hb_item_sales FROM __ask_scope_orders AS o JOIN __ask_scope_olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN hb_items AS hb ON o.order_id = hb.order_id LEFT JOIN rev AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ' AND o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-08-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-09-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) ORDER BY o.order_id
